integrity: The multiplication is reconstructed directly from the source MSC convention. The two cross-identifications are established by explicit bases; the finite-field computation is only a regression check and is not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The result isolates the \(As_{1,1}^{8}(3)(t)\) family and one redundancy in the complex comparison. It does not reassess the remaining families, and it makes no characteristic-two claim.
title: Quadratic-factor decomposition removes two spurious complex additions from a three-dimensional associative-algebra list
